title: Application for housing project at 63 Exterior Street, Bronx
summary: The city Department of Housing Preservation and Development seeks an Urban Development Action Area designation for property at 63 Exterior Street and 110 East 138th Street in the Bronx. The action would allow the city to dispose of the Exterior Street property to a developer chosen by HPD for a housing project. The site is in Community District 1 and Council District 8.
